summary: A dress up and makeup game specially designed for girls and adults
description:
Get ready to sparkle this holiday season with Doll Dress Up: Makeup Games! Step into a world of festive fashion and holiday magic as you style your dolls in stunning Christmas outfits and dazzling makeup looks. It’s time to bring the holiday cheer to your favorite dress-up game! 

Dress your dolls in exclusive holiday-themed outfits like Santa dresses, cozy sweaters, and elegant winter gowns.

Create magical makeup styles with glittery eyeshadows, frosty lipsticks and sparkling accessories.

Doll Dress Up: Sweet Girl creates a very serene and beautiful environment for designing your doll!

You are free to change them in different ways. Make a chic and adorable pastel chibi doll! Become a doll designer and let your creativity soar! Dress up your doll your own way, create your own anime character, choose the ideal clothes, add the coolest facial accessories, and bring your beautiful dolls to life!

How to play:
- Finger click to transform
- Wear appropriate accessories
- Dress up with different clothes and items
- Background arrangement
- Create unique photo memories

Feature:
- Click to transform
- Freedom of clothes
- Various background themes
- Lots of dress-up items
- Track all innovative designs

Ready to create your own character in Doll Dress Up: Sweet Girl?
